primary_source.title: Circulating but not faecal short-chain fatty acids are related to insulin sensitivity, lipolysis and GLP-1 concentrations in humans

source_bindings.fact: The paper explicitly lists NCT01826162 and NCT01983046 among the intervention studies contributing baseline data.
The paper states that in all included studies sample collection was performed after an overnight fast and measurements were conducted according to the same standard operating procedures.
Baseline blood samples were collected after an overnight fast greater than 10 hours.

source_bindings.locator: Methods / Analysis of faecal and circulating SCFA
source_bindings.fact: The paper specifies the circulating-SCFA sample preparation, reversed-phase separation and LTQ XL electrospray MS/MS workflow.

source_bindings.locator: Methods / Blood collection and biochemical analysis
source_bindings.fact: Blood for SCFA was collected in pre-chilled EDTA tubes, centrifuged at 3500 g at 4 C for 10 minutes, snap-frozen and stored at -80 C.

blocker_transition.claim_limit: This establishes a common reported baseline collection/measurement SOP for these trials within the 2019 combined-analysis provenance. It does not establish participant independence or separate per-trial reference distributions.
